name: RACE: Large-scale ReAding Comprehension Dataset from Examinations
description: RACE is a reading comprehension dataset collected from English examinations designed for middle school and high school students in China. It consists of 27,933 passages and 97,687 questions generated by human educational experts to assess comprehensive reading ability and reasoning.
